ORIGIN LABS / RESEARCH DEMONSTRATIONS

One evidence spine. Many domain verifiers.

Change the actor. Change the environment. Keep the question: what was checked, under which rules, and what evidence remains?

The agent reference check is the product. Labs explores the same evidence contract in bounded simulations and research demonstrations, not production products.

Explore the experiments
Try the reference check
Generated illustration of an experimental environment; not a robot deployment, Origin facility, or customer evidence.

THE EXPERIMENT INDEX

Different domains. Explicit limits.

Each demonstration pairs an actor with a domain verifier. Synthetic data, simulated actions, and mock credentials stay labeled at the point of use.

PHYSICAL ACTOR · MIXED ROBOT FLEET
Robot proving ground

Paint your own floor (walls, hazards, human-only zones) and place a simulated mixed fleet (humanoid, AMR, quadruped, arm, drone). Watch it in 2D + 3D; the oracle scores one episode per robot type and the fleet earns a Verified Readiness Level, sealed as a signed credential.

Domain verifier: the deterministic drawn-floor oracle (finish / escalate / refuse; catastrophic hard-caps the level).

Enter the proving ground →
SOFTWARE ACTOR · CREDENTIAL BROKER
Agent credential broker

An agent asks for access it does not hold. A named human approves one scoped grant, the broker mints an opaque lease handle, never a secret, and the value is resolved only at the tool-call boundary, then discarded. Revoke mid-flight and the next call fails closed.

Domain verifier: the grant ledger (approve / lease / revoke; every use recorded). Runs against a mock vault, no real credential is brokered here.

Open the broker demo →
PHYSICAL ACTOR · ROBOT PLAN
Verified warehouse

Multi-robot fleet follows the oracle’s BFS-verified plan, avoids a moving human + exclusion zones, and emits a signed attestation. Rendered in 2D and 3D.

Domain verifier: a deterministic grid/collision oracle (finish / escalate / refuse).

Open the simulation →
PERCEPTION · FLOOR PLANS
Origin Foundry

Explore a browser-local sample floor and a deterministic parse gate. Public image upload and provider-backed operations are disabled; those flows require a separately enabled local/backend demo and affirmative consent.

Domain verifier: a deterministic parse gate + BFS oracle over the proposed grid.

Open Foundry →
PHYSICAL ACTOR · FLEET OPERATIONS
Fleet operations experiment

Run a multi-wave shift; track utilization, peak-simultaneous, and collision counts and throughput. The simulated fleet earns a demo operations attestation only if it clears deterministic targets.

Domain verifier: a deterministic operations-SLA oracle over the verified run.

Open the ops console →
PERCEPTION ACTOR · SPATIAL MODEL
Spatial reconstruction verifier RESEARCH

A research direction for separating observed from inferred geometry and checking provenance before accepting spatial claims. The implementation is private and is not a public product surface.

Research focus: geometry and provenance checks. The link below demonstrates the public evidence verifier, not the private research system.

See how verification works →

Capability is not permission, for any autonomous actor. These demonstrations explore a shared evidence contract with synthetic, seeded, replayable inputs. Results mean reproducible under this verifier, never “safe,” production autonomy, or robot certification.

Look beneath the result.

The published research snapshot separates learned results, oracle-recovery upper bounds, generated counterfactuals, and the blocked real-customer evidence gate.
